Package Domain.Model

Class RespostesContainer

java.lang.Object
Domain.Model.RespostesContainer
public class RespostesContainer extends Object
Container for storing responses (RespostaEnquesta) associated with an Enquesta. Provides methods to add and retrieve responses and perform simple aggregations.
